jobs.title: Manager, Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants, Amazon Ads
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Ads is seeking an experienced technical leader to join our Services organization as a Manager of Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants, based in London. In this role, you'll lead a team of Technical Enablers supporting Amazon's largest advertisers and agencies across the EU market. You'll be responsible for building and scaling post-sales technical support capabilities, driving innovation in customer solutions, and ensuring your team delivers exceptional service quality to our enterprise customers.

Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.

As a manager, you will oversee a critical portion of our technical DSP Services team, which works with enterprise agency and advertiser customers. You will manage a team of Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants with expertise in advertising technology, programmatic advertising, and the Amazon DSP, who are leveraging this expertise to resolve a wide range of technical issues for our customers. Your team provides services ranging from custom training programs, to product and campaign strategy sessions, to technical troubleshooting. We help our customers understand how to integrate our technology into their workflow, driving self-sufficiency within the Amazon DSP.

You have experience managing a team and are able to work and inspire directly and indirectly across the EU and WW teams. You have a great track record of delivering complex projects and have impressed your stakeholders at all levels with your ability to communicate both written and verbally. You have demonstrated problem-solving capabilities across both technical and non-technical teams. The right candidate also possesses strong analytical acumen and is comfortable drawing metric-based conclusions by managing an extensive amount of data. You stay on top of industry and competitive trends, and you are able to execute at both a tactical and strategic level to drive customer satisfaction.

Key job responsibilities

Navigate a high level of ambiguity. You love whitespace, and treat this space as your own company. You identify key business problems to prioritize then present the solutions to solve them on behalf of the business.
Take ownership of managing a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants - Technical, including resource planning and driving success for the team’s customer category, possessing a complete understanding of internal and external variables that impact the business
Work tactically and strategically. Determines the right strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome of the assigned category
Be comfortable working with data to develop new opportunity areas, track program metrics, and use findings to influence business decisions
Set goals and direction for the team, ensuring alignment with broader business goals and vision
Hire, develop, and lead a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants - Technical
Thrive on technology and data and have expertise in monitoring and managing a services organization to maximum efficiency, productivity, and quality.
Generate and implement big ideas to drive business improvement, innovation, and scale within the team and across the business as a whole. Lead cross functional collaboration to get big ideas implemented.
Anticipate bottlenecks, assess risks, mitigate issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs
Have strong communication and written skills and experience working across diverse stakeholder groups
Represent Amazon when meeting with senior executive teams from top customers and build long term strategic relationships

A day in the life

Lead and develop a team of Technical Enablers who resolve complex campaign execution issues and blockers for enterprise customers, particularly programmatic trading desks
Drive operational excellence in technical issue resolution, ensuring your team provides knowledgeable and responsive support across our DSP product and processes
Establish and optimize processes for issue investigation, including identifying campaign configuration and software defects, reproducing complex cases, and researching solutions
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to influence roadmaps based on customer feedback and technical insights derived from your team's interactions
Develop and implement strategies to scale service quality, including the creation of tools and automation initiatives
Own relationships with key stakeholders Services, Product teams, and Support Engineering
Define and track success metrics around handling time, time to resolution, and service quality
Build mechanisms to scale knowledge across the organization and enable first-line support teams
Provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of customer incidents
Ensure your team maintains the high customer service bar set by Amazon, recognizing that our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers

Basic Qualifications

Experience as a manager with a track record of success
Experience in engineering teams management in a fast-paced operations environment
Experience managing IT environments on behalf of customers

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
Master of Business Administration
Experience driving projects to improve operations and support-related processes
Experience handling large enterprise technical customer escalations
Experience in AWS services
Experience in project and program management and delivering key business outcomes

jobs.title: Manager of Customer Success
jobs.description:
About Us

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

About The Role

STACK is looking for a Manager, Customer Success to build service-managed Customer Success from the ground up and lead the team that runs it. This role owns two distinct motions on day one: one covering 4000+ paying single-seat accounts, and the other two named books. There's no playbook to inherit here – you're writing it, staffing the pod that runs it, and proving the model works as you go.

You'll report to the VP, Customer Success, and manage a pod of 11 Customer Success Managers (CSMs), coaching them to build strong customer relationships, drive renewals and expansion, and make sure every account gets real value from the STACK platform.

What You'll Do

Pooled Queue Management – Keep coverage and response quality high across single-seat accounts, even at 1:many ratios.
Named Book Oversight – Manage two named books through CSMs who own the account relationship, renewal strategy, and expansion motion.
Team Leadership – Hire, onboard, coach, and manage a pod of 11 CSMs. Set clear goals, run regular 1:1s, and develop your team's skills over time.
Segmentation Strategy – Define and defend the line between SMB (pooled) and Enterprise (named) coverage as the book grows.
Retention & Growth – Own renewal and expansion targets across your team's book of business. Spot at-risk accounts early and build recovery plans that work.
Process & Playbooks – Build and refine the playbooks, health scoring, and workflows your team uses to manage accounts consistently at scale.
Cross-Functional Coordination – Partner with Sales, CS Ops, and Support to keep handoffs, escalations, and account signals moving cleanly.
Reporting & Forecasting – Build the forecast reviews, pod stand-ups, and QBWs that make a brand-new function predictable, and report progress to leadership.

Your First 90 Days

Agree the SMB/Enterprise threshold with Sales – in writing. Land a documented, mutually agreed definition of where the pooled queue ends and the named book begins.
Build the SMB 1:1 ramp. Design and launch the onboarding plan that gets new CSMs productive on the pooled queue fast.
Publish the signal library. Define and document the health signals the pod uses to prioritize accounts across both motions.
Run the manual interim queue until CS Ops lands. Own triage and routing by hand so coverage doesn't lapse while tooling catches up.
Document the fifth-head trip-wire. Define the specific, data-backed threshold that triggers the case for a 12th hire on the pod.

What You Bring

3+ years managing a Customer Success or Account Management team, ideally in SaaS, including experience across both pooled/SMB and named/Enterprise motions.
A track record of hitting or beating retention, renewal, and growth targets.
Strong coaching skills. You develop people, not just manage their output.
Comfort operating without fully built tooling or process – you'll run things manually in the near term while systems catch up.
Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard, spot a risk trend, and act on it.
A strong cross-functional partner, particularly with Sales on segmentation and CS Ops on tooling handoff.
Clear, confident communication with customers, your team, and cross-functional partners.
Experience in construction, real estate, or another vertical SaaS market is a plus, not a requirement.

Why Join STACK?

Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, remote-first environment.
Async-friendly environment with a focus on ownership and deep work.
Be part of a dynamic, supportive team where your contributions are valued.

At STACK, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers:

Radical Honesty: Communicate directly, respectfully, and transparently—even when conversations are difficult. Give and receive feedback with care.
Customer Obsession: Put the customer at the center of every decision. Solve real problems, follow through, and measure success by customer outcomes.
Move With Purpose: Take thoughtful action, remain accountable, and own both successes and mistakes. Anticipate what’s next and adapt as you learn.
Grow Together: Share knowledge, collaborate across teams, and invest in one another’s development. Celebrate collective wins and treat setbacks as opportunities to learn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

We take into account an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, 401(k) & paid time off. The expected compensation range for this position is about $118k-140k + quarterly bonus. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II
jobs.description:
About Us

At Todyl, we are on a mission to protect small and medium-sized businesses from ever-changing cyber threats. The Todyl platform fully integrates threat, risk, and compliance management to provide exceptional and affordable unified cybersecurity solutions to MSPs (Managed Service Providers) and their end customers.

At the end of the day, we're here to keep our partners and their customers safe, and to help them manage risk and comply with regulations. Protecting others requires a team that works together with trust and cares deeply about carrying out our mission.

About The Role

We're looking for a talented, high energy, collaborative person who wants to be part of a dynamic customer success team, changing the way businesses around the globe are connected and protected.

Todyl Customer Success Managers own long-term relationships with a portfolio of MSP partners, connecting with owners, technical leaders, and key stakeholders to drive their success on the Todyl platform. You will act as the link between partners and our internal teams, making sure the platform is delivered and adopted in a way that matches what the partner is trying to build. Our CSMs are dedicated to adding value to partners, championing their needs inside the company, and driving product usage and expansion.

This is a high-volume, leverage-driven book, not a handful of enterprise accounts. You will manage a large portfolio of MSP partners, and you'll be expected to use data, tooling, and good judgment to decide where your time goes each day.

This role reports to the Senior Director, Customer Success. Todyl has an in-office team, and this role is based in our Denver office.

Key Responsibilities

Own a portfolio of MSP partners: keep an accurate journey state on every account, engage proactively based on timing, usage, telemetry, and health scoring, and drive partners forward from their first 90 days to full adoption of the platform.
Lead every partner interaction with a value-add approach, following a defined methodology and playbooks to identify what each partner is trying to build and clearly convey the value of Todyl.
Identify the gap between what a partner is running today and what the platform can do for their business, and turn that into Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) for the Account Management team.

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions. STACK is looking for a Manager, Customer Success to build service-managed Customer Success from the ground up and lead the team that runs it. This role owns two distinct motions on day one: one covering 4000+ paying single-seat accounts, and the other two named books. There's no playbook to inherit here – you're writing it, staffing the pod that runs it, and proving the model works as you go.

You'll report to the VP, Customer Success, and manage a pod of 11 Customer Success Managers (CSMs), coaching them to build strong customer relationships, drive renewals and expansion, and make sure every account gets real value from the STACK platform.

What You'll Do

Pooled Queue Management – Keep coverage and response quality high across single-seat accounts, even at 1:many ratios.
Named Book Oversight – Manage two named books through CSMs who own the account relationship, renewal strategy, and expansion motion.
Team Leadership – Hire, onboard, coach, and manage a pod of 11 CSMs. Set clear goals, run regular 1:1s, and develop your team's skills over time.
Segmentation Strategy – Define and defend the line between SMB (pooled) and Enterprise (named) coverage as the book grows.
Retention & Growth – Own renewal and expansion targets across your team's book of business. Spot at-risk accounts early and build recovery plans that work.
Process & Playbooks – Build and refine the playbooks, health scoring, and workflows your team uses to manage accounts consistently at scale.
Cross-Functional Coordination – Partner with Sales, CS Ops, and Support to keep handoffs, escalations, and account signals moving cleanly.
Reporting & Forecasting – Build the forecast reviews, pod stand-ups, and QBWs that make a brand-new function predictable, and report progress to leadership.

Your First 90 Days

Agree the SMB/Enterprise threshold with Sales – in writing. Land a documented, mutually agreed definition of where the pooled queue ends and the named book begins.
Build the SMB 1:1 ramp. Design and launch the onboarding plan that gets new CSMs productive on the pooled queue fast.
Publish the signal library. Define and document the health signals the pod uses to prioritize accounts across both motions.
Run the manual interim queue until CS Ops lands. Own triage and routing by hand so coverage doesn't lapse while tooling catches up.
Document the fifth-head trip-wire. Define the specific, data-backed threshold that triggers the case for a 12th hire on the pod.

What You Bring

3+ years managing a Customer Success or Account Management team, ideally in SaaS, including experience across both pooled/SMB and named/Enterprise motions.
A track record of hitting or beating retention, renewal, and growth targets.
Strong coaching skills. You develop people, not just manage their output.
Comfort operating without fully built tooling or process – you'll run things manually in the near term while systems catch up.
Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard, spot a risk trend, and act on it.
A strong cross-functional partner, particularly with Sales on segmentation and CS Ops on tooling handoff.
Clear, confident communication with customers, your team, and cross-functional partners.
Experience in construction, real estate, or another vertical SaaS market is a plus, not a requirement.

Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, remote-first environment.
Async-friendly environment with a focus on ownership and deep work.
Be part of a dynamic, supportive team where your contributions are valued.

Radical Honesty: Communicate directly, respectfully, and transparently—even when conversations are difficult. Give and receive feedback with care.
Customer Obsession: Put the customer at the center of every decision. Solve real problems, follow through, and measure success by customer outcomes.

Humility, purpose over ego. Acknowledge mistakes, learn from others, and take feedback while putting the mission first.
